evidence_labels.throughput_interval: derived conditional scaling scenarios; not a conservative measured throughput bound
evidence_labels.venue_and_rate: vendor-reported public read-only inventory snapshot retrieved 2026-07-15

scope.workload: stock vLLM current AWQ, c8, 8192 input tokens and 1024 output tokens per request

venue.public_orderability_signal: Two matching A40 hostnodes in unauthenticated official inventory; this is a listing signal, not an authenticated allocation guarantee.
venue.included_terms: Minimum GPU, 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, and 20 GB local NVMe; public contract says millisecond proration and no ingress/egress fee. Local storage is not replicated.
venue.unbound_terms: Authenticated direct-instance lookup, deletion, checkout identity, and funded-account authorization remain unavailable in public evidence.

interpretation: The retained conditional interval 149.116-293.924 tok/s crosses every corrected threshold. Its lower scenario fails even the raw 187.797 tok/s threshold, and its 190.793 tok/s trace surrogate clears only the no-reserve case. Therefore neither a target close nor authority-worth-seeking is supported: the conservative lower scenario does not clear with lifecycle headroom.

one_future_measurement.signal: aggregate output tokens / measured matched-arm wall seconds
one_future_measurement.required_scope: exact revision, stock vLLM current AWQ, c8, 8192x1024 background workload, request rows, and GPU telemetry
one_future_measurement.external_authority_required: A funded authenticated TensorDock account with exact A40 hostnode revalidation, direct-instance lookup, and verified authenticated delete authority.
